subject: Post-call: ShopFlux context sizing & pricing confirmation
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflux.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: ShopFlux context sizing & pricing confirmation

Hi Elena — great to meet you today. Quick post-call recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a pilot quote and SOW. TL;DR: your team expects ~90M tokens/month baseline with spikes to ~250M; primary workloads are user-facing search completions + multi-turn summarization.

Recap (from our call):
- Primary use cases: search-ranked completion (short prompts, medium completions), multi-turn summarization for agent transcripts (longer context).
- Estimated monthly volume: baseline 90M tokens / month, Q3 peak test windows up to ~250M tokens / month.
- Average per-request profile we discussed: avg prompt tokens ~1,150; avg completion tokens ~950. Typical session = 2.8 requests.
- Context-length distribution: ~62% of requests fit within 8k context, ~33% require 32k, ~5% require 128k (mostly transcript summarization).
- Target unit economics (what you mentioned on call): target $/1M tokens in the ballpark of $900–$1,200 depending on commit and context mix.

Asks / next steps from us:
1) Can you confirm the monthly token distribution above (baseline vs peak) and the % split across 8k/32k/128k? If you have a small sample of logs (anonymized) we can run a quick profile.
2) Which SLAs matter most? (99.9% p99 latency, uptime, region preference). You mentioned US-east preference.
3) Is data residency or additional controls required beyond our standard Private options?

I've attached a short pricing model worksheet (shopflux-pricing-model-v1.xlsx) that contains two sample tiers: a 6-month pilot with commit-based discount and a 12-month reserved option. I'll run numbers for both once you confirm the distribution. Call recording attached for reference.

Next step: if you confirm distribution today, we can send a pilot SOW and a price table by Thursday (4/22).

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernández
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

---
Attachments:
- shopflux-pricing-model-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 25KB)
- call-recording-20270420.mp3 (audio/mpeg, 2.8MB)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflux.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Black <tom.black@shopflux.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: ShopFlux context sizing & pricing confirmation

Diego — thanks for the clear recap and for the worksheet. Quick clarifications from our side:

> - Estimated monthly volume: baseline 90M tokens / month, Q3 peak test windows up to ~250M tokens / month.

Those numbers look right for our MVP. To be explicit: baseline is for our search index (steady traffic). The 250M peak is a stress window during our holiday simulation in Oct. We expect 3–4 hour daily bursts then, not sustained full month.

> - Avg prompt tokens ~1,150; avg completion tokens ~950

Those averages align with the samples we reviewed, but one nuance: our search completions are shorter (avg completion ~450 tokens) while our transcript summarization completions average ~2,500 tokens. The blended average you wrote (950) is fine for planning, but please keep the two-mode split in mind.

> - Context-length distribution: ~62% 8k, ~33% 32k, ~5% 128k

Agree on distribution, though the 128k bucket might be closer to 3% in steady state. We'll send an anonymized log sample (JSON lines) of ~1k requests to help you profile. Attaching that will take me a day.

One ask on pricing: our procurement wants to see cost at three commitment levels: pilot (no commit, higher $/1M), 6‑month nominal commit, and 12‑month reserved (largest discount). Can you include per-context pricing (8k/32k/128k) per $/1M token so we can model?

We'll aim to share logs by EOD Thursday. If this helps, we can do a short follow-up on Friday to go over the worksheet.

—Elena
VP Product, ShopFlux
elena@shopflux.com
From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflux.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: ShopFlux context sizing & pricing confirmation

Thanks Elena — that nuance is very helpful (search short completions vs long transcript completions). Based on the split you provided and the ~90M baseline, here's a quick, conservative sketch of unit pricing we can present to procurement for modeling. I'll include this on the worksheet and then produce a formal table once we get the logs.

Assumptions used for the sketch:
- Baseline: 90M tokens/month (blended). Peak windows modeled separately.
- Blended per-request: prompt 1,150 tokens avg, completion blended 950 tokens avg (but we will show both short/long completion lines).
- Context distribution: 62% 8k, 33% 32k, 5% 128k (you said 3% for 128k; I'll include both scenarios).

Sketch pricing (per $/1M tokens) by commitment tier — illustrative only:
- Pilot / No commit: 8k = $1,600; 32k = $1,900; 128k = $2,800 per 1M tokens.
- 6-month commit (mid): 8k = $1,200; 32k = $1,450; 128k = $2,100 per 1M tokens.
- 12-month reserved (largest commit): 8k = $950; 32k = $1,100; 128k = $1,700 per 1M tokens.

Blended example (using your 62/33/5 split, pilot tier): blended = 0.62*1600 + 0.33*1900 + 0.05*2800 = ~$1,743 / 1M tokens.
Blended example (12-month reserved): ~0.62*950 + 0.33*1100 + 0.05*1700 = ~$1,010 / 1M tokens (inside your target band).

Other notes:
- We can reduce the 128k cost with caching and transcript pre-chunking for summarization; that would shift cost toward 32k behavior for many requests. Priyom (cc'd) can propose an operational pattern we used with a similar customer.
- SLA: we can offer p99 latency target for the reserved option and a best‑effort for pilot. Region = us-east as requested.

Next steps:
- Elena: send anonymized logs by EOD Thursday so we can finalize numbers.
- Redwood: we will update the worksheet with per-context $/1M rows and send a formal pilot SOW by Monday if logs arrive Thursday.
- Proposed quick sync: Fri 4/23, 30 minutes to walk the worksheet.

If that timeline works I'll draft the SOW outline this afternoon.

Diego
---
Attachments referenced:
- updated-pricing-sketch-notes.txt (plain text, 4KB)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflux.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Black <tom.black@shopflux.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: ShopFlux context sizing & pricing confirmation

Diego — thanks, that worked well. We shared a 1k-sample of anonymized logs in the Drive folder you linked (drive: /PricingDocs/shopflux_sample_logs.jsonl). Priyom, Laura: feel free to pull directly.

Procurement gave us a budget band to work with for the pilot: $25k–$40k / month. They prefer a 6-month mid-commit if the numbers are within the mid-tier pricing you sketched.

We'd like Redwood to prepare:
- Pilot SOW (30–60 day onboarding + 2-month pilot) with the pilot/non-commit pricing line plus an option to convert to 6-month commit at the mid tier.
- Per-context $/1M token table (8k/32k/128k) and a blended example using our distribution (please include both 5% and 3% 128k scenarios).

Quick note: please set the blended target we present to procurement at <= $1,200 / 1M tokens if possible (that's their hard internal threshold for moving to a 6-month commit).

We'll schedule the Friday sync if you still want that — Tom and I can do 11am PT.

—Elena
